name: Amount
description: Transaction amount in US dollars. Sent by the Super Banking BFF on every transaction authorization request. defaultValue 0 (like RarMaxAmount) so an ABSENT amount — every READ tool call — resolves to 0 instead of leaving the comparison unresolved; an unresolved NUMBER makes the whole decision INDETERMINATE. 0 trips no ceiling, so reads PERMIT and caps still deny.

name: TransactionType
description: One of: transfer, withdrawal, deposit. Sent by the Super Banking BFF on every transaction authorization request.

name: UserId
description: PingOne user ID — the sub claim from the user's access token. Sent on both transaction and MCP authorization requests.

name: Acr
description: Authentication context class reference — the step-up level already met by the user (e.g. Multi_Factor). Sent on both transaction and MCP authorization requests.

name: Timestamp
description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the transaction request. Sent by the Super Banking BFF on every transaction authorization request.

name: ipAddress
description: Client IP address of the transaction request. Sent by the Super Banking BFF on every authorization request.

name: DecisionContext
description: Identifies the type of MCP authorization check. Always 'McpFirstTool' for MCP first-tool gate requests from the Super Banking BFF.

name: ToolName
description: Name of the MCP tool being invoked (e.g. banking_get_accounts, banking_transfer_funds). Sent by the Super Banking BFF on MCP first-tool gate requests.

name: TokenAudience
description: The aud claim of the presented MCP access token. Must match McpResourceUri to pass delegation validation.

name: ActClientId
description: act.client_id from the MCP access token — the immediate actor in the RFC 8693 delegation chain. MCP Exchanger (f4dd707d-f78d-4417-ba56-dc8707d10a1f) for normal MCP path; specialist client ID for A2A two-hop path.

name: NestedActClientId
description: act.act.client_id or act.act.sub — the upstream agent actor when nested delegation is present (multi-hop RFC 8693 chains).

name: McpResourceUri
description: The expected MCP server resource URI. TokenAudience must match this value for the delegation chain to be valid (e.g. https://mcp-server.pingdemo.com).

name: HitlApproved
description: True when the BFF has verified an approved, caller-bound HITL challenge receipt for this tool call. Emitted as boolean true only on verified retries; absent on first-call (treated as false by default). Do NOT use to discharge step-up MFA — a receipt is human approval, not an MFA credential.

name: ActChainDepth
description: RFC 8693 act chain depth: 0 = no delegation, 1 = single-hop (MCP Exchanger acting on behalf of user), 2 = two-hop A2A (specialist delegated by generalist). Sent by the MCP gateway on every MCP authorization request.

name: UserTier
description: UC21 entitlement tier, resolved by the BFF from the user's PingOne group membership (UserGroups.includes('PrivateBanking') ? 'PrivateBanking' : 'Standard'). Mirrors NNP8_TIER_POLICY in simulatedAuthorizeService.js / demo_authz_server. Sent on MCP tool-call requests ONLY when ff_authorize_group_policy is on; default 'none' makes the tier rules inert otherwise.

name: RequiredGroup
description: UC9 group/entitlement check — the group the invoked tool requires, or 'none' if unrestricted. Resolved by the BFF (groupPolicy.requiredGroupForTool) and sent on MCP tool-call requests ONLY when ff_authorize_group_policy is on. Mirrors RequiredGroup in simulatedAuthorizeService.js / demo_authz_server.

name: InRequiredGroup
description: UC9 — BFF-resolved boolean: does the user's group list contain RequiredGroup (userGroups.includes(requiredGroup))? Pre-resolved by the BFF because the snapshot DSL has no array-contains operator; mirrors the simulated engine's !userGroups.includes(requiredGroup) deny. Default true so the rule is inert when no group check is sent.

name: IsLargeTransaction
description: Amount exceeds $2,000 — unconditional DENY threshold in Super Banking policy.

name: IsTransferOrWithdrawal
description: Transaction type is transfer or withdrawal — these require step-up MFA for high-value amounts.

name: HasMFAAuthentication
description: User has already completed multi-factor authentication — ACR equals Multi_Factor.

name: IsHighValueTransaction
description: Amount exceeds $500 — step-up MFA threshold for transfers and withdrawals.

name: RequiresStepUp
description: Transaction requires step-up MFA: amount > $500, type is transfer or withdrawal, and user has NOT yet completed MFA.

name: HasValidUserId
description: UserId is present and not the default sentinel value 'none'.

name: HasValidMcpAudience
description: TokenAudience (the token's real aud) is one of the accepted gateway identities (mcpgateway.ping.demo, mcpgateway-a2a.ping.demo, https://api.ping.demo:3036/mcp, https://api.ping.demo:3036/mcp/apikey). A token minted for any other resource fails this and is denied by "MCP Deny — Invalid Token Audience". Generated from scope-topology.json gateway resource URIs for the AI Demo environment — do not hand-edit.

name: IsMcpFirstToolRequest
description: DecisionContext is one of McpFirstTool, McpToolCall, McpToolsList, McpRequest — identifies an MCP request (BFF first-tool gate, gateway tool call, tool discovery, or session lifecycle) and routes it to the MCP Delegation policy. Generated — do not hand-edit.

name: HasValidActorChain
description: ActClientId is one of the registered chain identities (13): the MCP Token Exchanger, the AI Agent, and each A2A specialist. A two-hop chain whose specialist is not listed here is denied as an invalid actor, regardless of chain depth. Union of the ids already in the snapshot and PINGONE_A2A_*_AGENT_CLIENT_ID — never shrinks.

name: RequiresHitlConsent
description: ToolName is one of the consent-gated tools (book_appointment, checkout, create_transfer, delete_customer, extend_rental, get_sensitive_account_details, request_time_off, sensitive_airline_bookings, sensitive_customer_identity, sensitive_holdings, sensitive_membership_details, sensitive_order_history, sensitive_passenger_record, sensitive_patient_records, sensitive_payroll_details, sensitive_student_finance, sensitive_supplier_contract, sensitive_tax_record) AND HitlApproved is not true. Fires the HITL approval obligation. On a verified retry (HitlApproved=true) this is false and the call proceeds. Generated from scope-topology.json (challengeType=consent) — do not hand-edit.

name: RequiresA2aDelegation
description: ToolName is one of the A2A-delegated tools (get_investment_accounts, get_investment_balance, get_investment_transactions, get_portfolio_summary, sensitive_customer_identity, sensitive_holdings, sensitive_membership_details, sensitive_order_history, sensitive_passenger_record, sensitive_patient_records, sensitive_payroll_details, sensitive_student_finance, sensitive_supplier_contract, sensitive_tax_record) AND ActChainDepth < 2, i.e. NOT(ActChainDepth > 1) — the caller is not a specialist acting under a two-hop act chain. Fires the delegation-required DENY. Generated from scope-topology.json (a2aDelegated) — do not hand-edit.

name: HasValidA2aGeneralist
description: NestedActClientId matches the registered AI Agent generalist (71e878ea-2d79-4760-b570-66f00cbeffe7). Confirms the specialist was delegated by the correct generalist, not by an arbitrary caller.

name: RequiresMcpStepUp
description: ToolName is one of the step-up-gated tools (adjust_balance, cancel_airline_reservation, cash_out_store_credit, create_deposit, create_wire_transfer, create_withdrawal, freeze_account, large_trade, release_record, release_records, release_transcript, release_work_order, reset_customer_password, submit_expense, transfer_membership) AND the user has NOT completed MFA. Fires the step-up obligation on the MCP path. Generated from scope-topology.json (challengeType=step_up) — do not hand-edit.

name: IsConsentTransaction
description: Amount exceeds $250 — the consent (HITL) threshold for transactions. Step-up ($500) and deny ($2,000) take precedence in the BFF obligation classifier.

name: IsStandardTier
description: UC21: UserTier equals 'Standard' — the default, capped tier (manifest tiers.default). The other tiers and the inert attribute default 'none' do not match, so every tier rule is dormant until the BFF sends UserTier (ff_authorize_group_policy on). Generated from the banking manifest tiers block — do not hand-edit.

name: IsTierRestrictedTool
description: UC21: ToolName is one of the 2 tool(s) a 'Standard' user may not call (create_withdrawal, withdraw) — group membership EXPANDS capability. Union of the manifest's tiers.definitions.Standard.restrictedTools and the ids already imported; never shrinks. Generated — do not hand-edit the list.

name: TierToolNotAllowed
description: UC21 deny (tier_tool_not_allowed): a Standard-tier user invoking a PrivateBanking-only tool. Mirrors simulatedAuthorizeService.js guard (a).

name: ExceedsTierAmountCap
description: UC21 deny (tier_amount_exceeded): Amount exceeds the caller's per-tier ceiling — Standard $2,000, PrivateBanking $50,000. Applied to EVERY tier, not just the capped one. Ceilings are generated from the banking manifest tiers.definitions[*].maxAmountUsd — the same numbers groupPolicy.getTierDefinitions() gives the simulated engine — so the two engines cannot disagree. Do not hand-edit.

name: GroupMembershipFailed
description: UC9 deny (user_not_in_group): a group-restricted tool (RequiredGroup != 'none') where the BFF-resolved InRequiredGroup is false. Mirrors simulatedAuthorizeService.js !userGroups.includes(requiredGroup).

name: RarMaxAmount
description: RFC 9396 RAR granted amount ceiling (azd.authorization_details[0].amount). Sent by the AI Demo BFF/gateway on delegated tool calls that carry a RAR grant; absent otherwise. defaultValue 0 (like HitlApproved=false) so an ABSENT grant resolves to 0 instead of leaving the comparison unresolved — an unresolved NUMBER makes the rule (and the whole MCP decision) INDETERMINATE.

name: TokenAudActual
description: The ACTUAL aud claim of the presented token, as introspected (single value; a multi-aud token is space-joined and only caught at the PEP). Used by the D-05 anti-bypass deny. Default '' keeps the rule inert when absent.

name: ResourceOwnerId
description: PingOne user id that OWNS the target resource, when the caller can name it. '' (default) means unknown/not applicable and keeps the rule inert. Compared against UserId by the resource-owner deny (mock Rule 3.5a).

name: IntentTokenValid
description: 'true' | 'false' | '' — whether the gateway validated a presented intent token. '' (default) means absent/disabled and keeps both intent rules inert.

name: IntentMatchesTool
description: 'true' | 'false' | '' — whether the invoked tool is in the validated intent token's permitted_tools. Only consulted when IntentTokenValid='true'.

name: IntentTokenError
description: Why intent-token validation failed (malformed, invalid_signature, malformed_payload, expired, ...). Empty when valid/absent. Only tamper-class errors deny (mock INTENT_TAMPER_ERRORS).

name: UserRole
description: Caller role forwarded by the BFF ('admin' | 'customer'; lowercase). Default 'none' keeps the admin restriction inert. A RESTRICTION input only — never a bypass (see mock Rule 2.95 / F5).

name: TokenKidKnown
description: BFF-pre-resolved JWKS membership of the presented token header kid. true = the kid is published in the issuer's JWKS; false = it is not. The BFF OMITS this key when it cannot resolve membership, and the default is TRUE so an absent value never denies — a JWKS outage degrades this check instead of denying every call. Pre-resolved BFF-side because this DSL cannot fetch a JWKS (same reason as InRequiredGroup).

name: TokenKid
description: The kid from the presented token header. Reportable input only — no rule branches on it; TokenKidUnpublished reads TokenKidKnown. Present so the deny payload and PingOne's recent-decisions log can name the key. Default '' when the header carries no kid.

name: RarAmountExceeded
description: RarMaxAmount > 0 (a RAR grant is present) AND Amount > RarMaxAmount. Absent grant → false → non-RAR calls unaffected. Mirrors simulatedAuthorizeService NNP-1.

name: RAR Amount Exceeded
description: Returned when the requested amount exceeds the RFC 9396 RAR granted ceiling. code rar_amount_exceeded surfaces as the deny_reason in the BFF/Token Chain.
payload: RAR amount enforcement: requested ${{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}} exceeds the granted ceiling of ${{12345678-0020-4321-abcd-000000000020}} (RFC 9396 authorization_details). The agent cannot exceed the attested limit even with a valid token.

name: Deny RAR Amount Overage
description: DENY when Amount exceeds the RFC 9396 RAR granted ceiling (RarMaxAmount). No RAR grant → condition false → permit contribution only. PingOne-side twin of the gateway requireRarIntent check.

name: TokenAudTargetsUpstream
description: TokenAudActual equals one of the upstream/backend audiences behind the gateway (mcpserver.ping.demo, mcp-invest.ping.demo, https://banking-resource-server.ping.demo). A client must obtain a gateway-targeted token and let the gateway exchange it for the next hop (D-05, mock Rule 0b-2). Single-aud comparison only — space-joined multi-aud values are caught at the PEP. Generated from scope-topology.json resources — do not hand-edit.

name: ResourceOwnerMismatch
description: ResourceOwnerId is present AND does not equal UserId — the requester is not the owner of the target resource (account-takeover / Meta-chatbot pattern, mock Rule 3.5a). Attribute-to-attribute NotEquals is supported by the DSL.

name: IntentTokenTampered
description: IntentTokenValid = 'false' AND IntentTokenError is a tamper-class failure (malformed, invalid_signature, malformed_payload). A tampered/forged intent token fails CLOSED (mock Rule 4a); a benign 'expired' failure or an absent token does not match.

name: IntentToolMismatch
description: IntentTokenValid = 'true' AND IntentMatchesTool = 'false' — a VALID intent token was presented but the invoked tool is not in its permitted_tools (mock Rule 4b). Absent tokens ('') do not match.

name: AdminRoleOnWriteTool
description: UserRole is 'admin' AND ToolName is one of the 88 customer write tools (requiredScopes includes 'write' in scope-topology.json — same derivation as scopeTopology.isWriteTool). Mirrors mock Rule 2.95. Generated — do not hand-edit.

name: TokenKidUnpublished
description: TokenKidKnown = false — the token header names a signing key the issuer does not publish. Absent/unknown (attribute default true) does NOT match, so the rule is inert unless the BFF positively resolved the kid as unpublished. Key-identity check only; signature verification happens at authentication.

name: Transaction Denied
description: Returned when a transaction is unconditionally denied by policy (amount exceeds $2,000).
payload: Transaction denied: amount ${{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}} exceeds the maximum permitted limit of $2,000. TransactionType: {{12345678-0002-4321-abcd-000000000002}}.

name: Transaction Approved
description: Returned when a transaction passes all Super Banking policy checks.

name: Step-Up MFA Required
description: Returned when a high-value transfer or withdrawal requires MFA before proceeding. The BFF checks for code 'step-up-required' and payload.stepUpRequired=true to trigger HTTP 428.
payload: {"stepUpRequired": true, "message": "Transaction of ${{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}} ({{12345678-0002-4321-abcd-000000000002}}) requires multi-factor authentication before proceeding.", "amount": "{{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}}", "transactionType": "{{12345678-0002-4321-abcd-000000000002}}", "currentAcr": "{{12345678-0004-4321-abcd-000000000004}}", "requiredAcr": "Multi_Factor"}

name: MCP Tool Authorization Denied
description: Returned when the MCP delegation chain fails validation — invalid audience, missing user ID, or invalid actor chain.

name: MCP Tool Authorized
description: Returned when the MCP delegation chain passes all validation checks. The AI agent may proceed with the tool invocation.

name: MCP Denied — Invalid Audience
description: Specific denial statement when TokenAudience does not match McpResourceUri.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "invalid-audience", "message": "Token audience '{{12345678-0009-4321-abcd-000000000009}}' does not match expected MCP resource URI '{{12345678-0012-4321-abcd-000000000012}}'. The MCP token was not issued for this server."}

name: MCP Denied — Missing User ID
description: Specific denial statement when UserId is absent from the MCP token chain.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "missing-user-id", "message": "No user identity found in the MCP token delegation chain. UserId is required for all Super Banking MCP tool invocations."}

name: MCP Denied — Invalid Actor Chain
description: Specific denial statement when ActClientId does not match the MCP Exchanger or any registered A2A specialist agent.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "invalid-actor-chain", "message": "Actor client ID '{{12345678-0010-4321-abcd-000000000010}}' is not a registered actor in the RFC 8693 delegation chain.", "actClientId": "{{12345678-0010-4321-abcd-000000000010}}"}

name: HITL Approval Required
description: Returned when the AI agent's tool call requires human-in-the-loop approval before proceeding. The BFF reads code 'HITL' and payload.hitlRequired=true to return HTTP 428. On retry with a verified receipt (HitlApproved=true), the RequiresHitlConsent condition is false, this rule is skipped, and the tool proceeds via the standard Permit Valid rule.
payload: {"hitlRequired": true, "message": "Tool '{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}' requires human approval before proceeding.", "toolName": "{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}"}

name: MCP Denied — A2A Delegation Required
description: Returned when an A2A-delegated tool is called without a two-hop act chain — the generalist acting alone, or no delegation at all. PingOne Authorize validates the RFC 8693 chain depth, not just the immediate actor.
payload: {"denied":true,"reason":"a2a-delegation-required","message":"A2A delegation is required for this tool: the call did not arrive through a two-hop act chain (specialist delegated by the generalist). The generalist acting alone is denied."}

name: Deny Large Transactions
description: DENY any transaction where Amount > $2,000. This is an unconditional block regardless of transaction type, ACR level, or user identity.

name: Require Step-Up MFA for High-Value Transfers
description: PERMIT (with step-up obligation) when: Amount > $500 AND TransactionType is transfer or withdrawal AND user has NOT completed MFA (Acr != Multi_Factor). The BFF reads the step-up-required statement code and payload.stepUpRequired=true to return HTTP 428.

name: Transaction Consent Required
description: Returned when a transaction is at or above the $250 consent threshold and requires explicit human approval. Code contains HITL_CONSENT so the BFF obligation classifier sets consentRequired (HTTP 428).
payload: {"consentRequired": true, "message": "Transaction of ${{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}} requires explicit consent before proceeding.", "amount": "{{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}}"}

name: Require Consent for Mid-Value Transactions
description: PERMIT with consent obligation when Amount > $250. Step-up ($500 transfers/withdrawals) and Deny ($2,000) take precedence via DenyOverrides + the BFF obligation classifier (step-up dominates consent).

name: Permit Standard Transactions
description: PERMIT all transactions not caught by the Deny or Step-Up rules. This includes: amounts <= $500 of any type; high-value transfers/withdrawals where the user HAS completed MFA; all deposits regardless of amount.

name: MCP Deny — Invalid Token Audience
description: DENY when TokenAudience does not match McpResourceUri. Confirms the MCP token was issued for the correct resource server.

name: MCP Deny — Missing User ID
description: DENY when UserId is absent or equal to the sentinel 'none'. All Super Banking MCP tool calls require an authenticated user identity in the token chain.

name: MCP Deny — Invalid Actor Chain
description: DENY when ActClientId is not one of the 13 registered chain identities (the MCP Token Exchanger, the AI Agent, and each A2A specialist). Validates the RFC 8693 delegation chain has a known registered actor. Generated — do not hand-edit the list.

name: MCP Require HITL Consent for sensitive tools
description: PERMIT with HITL obligation when ToolName is a consent-gated tool and HitlApproved is not true (see RequiresHitlConsent, generated from scope-topology.json challengeType=consent). On a verified receipt retry the condition is false and the call proceeds via MCP Permit Valid. HitlApproved MUST NOT discharge step-up MFA.

name: MCP Deny — Invalid A2A Generalist
description: DENY when the call comes through a two-hop A2A chain (ActChainDepth >= 2) but the nested generalist (NestedActClientId) is not the registered AI Agent. PingOne Authorize validates the full RFC 8693 chain: the specialist must have been delegated by the authorized generalist, not by an arbitrary caller.

name: MCP Require Step-Up for sensitive tools
description: PERMIT with step-up obligation when ToolName is a step-up-gated tool and the user has not completed MFA (see RequiresMcpStepUp, generated from scope-topology.json challengeType=step_up). The BFF returns HTTP 428 (mcp_step_up_required).

name: MCP Permit Valid Tool Invocation
description: PERMIT MCP tool invocation when all validation checks pass: TokenAudience matches McpResourceUri, UserId is present, and ActClientId is a registered actor.

name: MCP Denied — Tier Tool Not Allowed
description: UC21 (tier_tool_not_allowed): a Standard-tier user attempted a PrivateBanking-only tool. Mirrors NNP8_TIER_POLICY deny in simulatedAuthorizeService.js / demo_authz_server.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "tier_tool_not_allowed", "message": "UC21 entitlement-tier capability — tool '{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}' is restricted to PrivateBanking members. User tier is '{{12345678-0015-4321-abcd-000000000015}}'. Group membership EXPANDS capability; Standard users cannot invoke high-value wire operations regardless of scope.", "toolName": "{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}", "userTier": "{{12345678-0015-4321-abcd-000000000015}}"}

name: MCP Denied — Tier Amount Exceeded
description: UC21 (tier_amount_exceeded): a Standard-tier request exceeded the $2,000 ceiling. Mirrors NNP8_TIER_POLICY.Standard.maxAmountUsd in simulatedAuthorizeService.js / demo_authz_server.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "tier_amount_exceeded", "message": "UC21 entitlement-tier capability — ${{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}} exceeds the '{{12345678-0015-4321-abcd-000000000015}}' tier ceiling of $2,000. PrivateBanking members have a $50,000 ceiling.", "amount": "{{12345678-0001-4321-abcd-000000000001}}", "userTier": "{{12345678-0015-4321-abcd-000000000015}}"}

name: MCP Denied — Not In Required Group
description: UC9 (user_not_in_group): the user is not a member of the group the tool requires. Mirrors the group guard in simulatedAuthorizeService.js / demo_authz_server.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "user_not_in_group", "message": "Group membership check failed — tool '{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}' requires membership in '{{12345678-0016-4321-abcd-000000000016}}' which user '{{12345678-0003-4321-abcd-000000000003}}' does not hold. Even with a valid token and scope, least-privilege blocks access the user's group does not grant.", "requiredGroup": "{{12345678-0016-4321-abcd-000000000016}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Tier Tool Not Allowed
description: UC21: DENY when a Standard-tier user invokes a PrivateBanking-only tool (TierToolNotAllowed). Inert unless the BFF sends UserTier='Standard' (only when ff_authorize_group_policy is on). DenyOverrides means this wins.

name: MCP Deny — Tier Amount Exceeded
description: UC21: DENY when a Standard-tier request exceeds the $2,000 ceiling (ExceedsStandardTierCap). Inert unless the BFF sends UserTier='Standard' + Amount. DenyOverrides means this wins.

name: MCP Deny — Not In Required Group
description: UC9: DENY when the tool is group-restricted and the BFF-resolved InRequiredGroup is false (GroupMembershipFailed). Inert unless the BFF sends RequiredGroup != 'none' (only when ff_authorize_group_policy is on). DenyOverrides means this wins.

name: MCP Denied — Audience Targets Upstream
description: D-05 (bypass_attempt): the token's actual aud targets an upstream resource behind the gateway — a confused-deputy bypass. Mirrors mock Rule 0b-2 and the Node gateway GatewayTokenPolicy.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "bypass_attempt", "message": "Token aud '{{12345678-0018-4321-abcd-000000000018}}' targets an upstream resource behind the gateway. Obtain a gateway-targeted token and let the gateway exchange it for the next hop (D-05).", "tokenAudActual": "{{12345678-0018-4321-abcd-000000000018}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Audience Targets Upstream
description: DENY when TokenAudActual equals an upstream/backend audience (TokenAudTargetsUpstream). D-05 anti-bypass, mirroring mock Rule 0b-2. Single-aud only — multi-aud bypasses are caught at the PEP.

name: MCP Denied — Resource Owner Mismatch
description: NNP-3/UC10 (resource_owner_mismatch): the target resource belongs to a different user than the requester. Mirrors mock Rule 3.5a.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "resource_owner_mismatch", "message": "Target resource belongs to '{{12345678-0019-4321-abcd-000000000019}}' but the request was made by '{{12345678-0003-4321-abcd-000000000003}}'. Possible cross-user resource access (account-takeover pattern).", "resourceOwnerId": "{{12345678-0019-4321-abcd-000000000019}}", "userId": "{{12345678-0003-4321-abcd-000000000003}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Resource Owner Mismatch
description: DENY when ResourceOwnerId is present and differs from UserId (ResourceOwnerMismatch). Mirrors mock Rule 3.5a; inert when the caller cannot name an owner.

name: MCP Denied — Intent Token Invalid
description: Intent binding (intent_token_invalid): a presented intent token failed validation with a tamper-class error. Mirrors mock Rule 4a.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "intent_token_invalid", "message": "Presented intent token failed validation ({{12345678-0023-4321-abcd-000000000023}}). Tampered or forged intent tokens fail closed.", "intentTokenError": "{{12345678-0023-4321-abcd-000000000023}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Intent Token Invalid
description: DENY when a presented intent token is tampered (IntentTokenTampered — valid=false with a tamper-class error). Mirrors mock Rule 4a; expired/absent tokens are not denied here.

name: MCP Denied — Intent Tool Mismatch
description: Intent binding (intent_mismatch): the tool is not permitted by the validated intent token. Mirrors mock Rule 4b.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "intent_mismatch", "message": "Tool '{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}' is not in the validated intent token's permitted_tools.", "toolName": "{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Intent Tool Mismatch
description: DENY when a valid intent token does not permit the invoked tool (IntentToolMismatch). Mirrors mock Rule 4b; inert when no intent token is presented.

name: MCP Denied — Admin Role Not Permitted
description: Rule 2.95 (admin_role_not_permitted): an admin session may not drive customer write tools through the agent. Parity with requireNotAdmin; admin is a restriction, never a bypass.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "admin_role_not_permitted", "message": "Tool '{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}' mutates customer account state and is not available to an admin role. Switch to a customer session.", "toolName": "{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}", "userRole": "{{12345678-0024-4321-abcd-000000000024}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Admin Role Not Permitted
description: DENY when UserRole=admin invokes a customer write tool (AdminRoleOnWriteTool, generated from scope-topology.json). Mirrors mock Rule 2.95 / requireNotAdmin. Restriction only — no admin permit branch exists.

name: MCP Denied — Invalid Signing Key
description: Signing-key identity (invalid_kid): the token header names a kid that is not published in the issuer JWKS. Mirrors the simulated engine deny_reason invalid_kid. Not a signature-verification failure.
payload: {"denied": true, "reason": "invalid_kid", "message": "The token header names signing key '{{12345678-0028-4321-abcd-000000000028}}' which is not published in the issuer's JWKS. This is a key-identity check, not signature verification.", "kid": "{{12345678-0028-4321-abcd-000000000028}}", "toolName": "{{12345678-0008-4321-abcd-000000000008}}"}

name: MCP Deny — Invalid Signing Key
description: DENY when the BFF resolved the token header kid as absent from the issuer JWKS (TokenKidUnpublished). Inert when TokenKidKnown is omitted — unknown is not "verified absent".

name: AI Demo Transaction Authorization
description: Authorizes AI Demo banking transactions. Evaluates Amount, TransactionType, and Acr against policy rules. DenyOverrides: if any rule produces DENY the final decision is DENY. Rules in priority order: (1) DENY if Amount > $2,000; (2) PERMIT+step-up if Amount > $500 and type is transfer/withdrawal and no MFA; (3) PERMIT otherwise. Context guard: only evaluates when NOT IsMcpFirstToolRequest (i.e. DecisionContext != McpFirstTool).

name: AI Demo MCP Delegation Authorization
description: Authorizes MCP tool invocations from the AI Demo agent. Validates the RFC 8693 actor delegation chain: TokenAudience must match McpResourceUri, UserId must be present, ActClientId must be the MCP Exchanger (normal path) or a registered A2A specialist (A2A path). DenyOverrides: any DENY wins.
